Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class SentimentDashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.SentimentDashboardController
@Controller public class SentimentDashboardController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller that renders the company sentiment and risk dashboard.

Serves GET /dashboard/risk showing all tracked companies with their sentiment scores, risk summaries, and distribution breakdowns. Tier gating: FREE users see the top 5 companies; SUBSCRIBER/DEMO/ADMIN see all.
